adamant.en: very sure and not willing to change
adamant.ex: She was adamant that she had paid the bill.

address.ex: The council promised to address the parking problem.

advocates.en: people who publicly support an idea
advocates.ex: Advocates of cycling want more bike lanes in the city.
advocates.zh: 倡導者；支持者（亦作動詞：提倡）

aim.ex: The new policy aims to reduce traffic.

aims.ex: The new policy aims to reduce traffic.

anniversary.en: the same date a past event happened
anniversary.ex: The café is celebrating its tenth anniversary this week.

another.en: one more of the same kind

approximately.ex: The film lasts approximately two hours.

argue.en: to give reasons for an opinion
argue.ex: Critics argue that the plan is too expensive.

as.en: in the role or way of

at.en: in or near a place or time

bankrolled.ex: A local businessman bankrolled the new sports club.

barracks.en: part of a school name (once a soldiers' building)

be.en: exist or have a quality; used in passives

been.ex: It has been a busy week.

begin.ex: The talks will begin next week.

being.ex: The main idea being simple, everyone understood.

believes.en: thinks something is true or right
believes.ex: My coach believes that practice matters more than talent.
believes.ja: 信じている；考えている

boosts.ex: A good night's sleep boosts your energy.

builds.en: makes something grow or plans it around something
builds.ex: Team sport builds trust between players.

called.ex: He called for a change in the law.

celebrating.en: marking a special day with happy events
celebrating.ex: The town is celebrating the end of the harvest.

census.en: an official count of a country's people
census.ex: The census showed the city had grown quickly.

cent.ex: Prices rose by five per cent.

change.ex: The new manager wants to change the opening hours.

children.ex: Every child needs a safe place to play.

children's.ex: The children's drawings hung on the wall.

classes.ex: Her dance classes start at six o'clock.

classroom.en: a room where pupils are taught
classroom.ex: The classroom was full of colourful posters.

close.en: to make a difference smaller or disappear
close.ex: The school wants to close the gap between rich and poor pupils.

comes.en: when it comes to: on the subject of
comes.ex: When it comes to cooking, my dad is the expert.
comes.zh: when it comes to：說到；在…方面

commence.ex: The course will commence in September.

communication.en: sharing ideas and information with others
communication.ex: Good communication helps a team work well.

communicative.ex: The course focuses on communicative ability, not just grammar.
communicative.ja: コミュニケーションの

community.en: group of people living or acting together
community.ex: The community planted trees in the park.

compared.en: when you look at both together
compared.ex: Prices are high compared with last year.

competence.en: the ability to do something well
competence.ex: She showed great competence in handling the crisis.

example.en: The course builds students' competence in basic first aid.
example.zh: 這門課程培養學生基本急救的能力。

note.meaning: 能力、勝任程度，指能把事情做好所需的知識與技能。
note.usage: 常用 competence in + 領域；語言學中 communicative competence 指溝通能力。

noteEn.meaning: The ability to do something well.
noteEn.usage: Use 'competence in' a skill or subject.

noteEs.exampleTr: El curso desarrolla la competencia de los alumnos en primeros auxilios básicos.
noteEs.usage: Se usa competence in + campo; communicative competence es la capacidad de comunicarse.

noteHi.exampleTr: यह पाठ्यक्रम छात्रों में बुनियादी प्राथमिक चिकित्सा की दक्षता बढ़ाता है।
noteHi.meaning: किसी काम को अच्छी तरह करने की योग्यता या क्षमता।
noteHi.usage: competence in + क्षेत्र के रूप में आता है; communicative competence यानी संवाद क्षमता।

noteJa.exampleTr: その講座は学生の基本的な応急手当の能力を高める。
noteJa.meaning: 物事をうまく行うための能力。
noteJa.usage: competence in + 分野 の形。communicative competence は「伝達能力」。

noteKo.exampleTr: 그 과정은 학생들의 기초 응급처치 능력을 길러 준다.
noteKo.meaning: 어떤 일을 잘 해낼 수 있는 능력.
noteKo.usage: competence in + 분야 형태로 쓰며, communicative competence는 의사소통 능력이다.

confidence.ex: Speaking on stage gave him more confidence.

confident.en: sure of yourself and your abilities
confident.ex: After practice, she felt confident about the exam.

consolidates.en: makes something stronger and more secure
consolidates.ex: Regular revision consolidates what you learn in class.

example.en: Weekly quizzes help pupils consolidate new vocabulary.
example.zh: 每週的小測驗幫助學生鞏固新學的詞彙。

note.meaning: 鞏固、加強，使已有的知識或地位更穩固。
note.usage: 後接名詞，常與 knowledge、position、learning 搭配；也可指合併。

noteEn.meaning: Makes something stronger or more secure.

noteEs.exampleTr: Los cuestionarios semanales ayudan a los alumnos a consolidar el vocabulario nuevo.
noteEs.meaning: Reforzar algo que ya existe, como conocimientos o una posición.
noteEs.usage: Lleva sustantivo: consolidate knowledge, position, learning; también significa fusionar.

noteHi.exampleTr: साप्ताहिक प्रश्नोत्तरी छात्रों को नई शब्दावली मज़बूत करने में मदद करती है।
noteHi.meaning: पहले से मौजूद ज्ञान या स्थिति को और मज़बूत करना।
noteHi.usage: संज्ञा के साथ आता है, जैसे knowledge, position, learning; इसका अर्थ 'मिलाना' भी हो सकता है।

noteJa.exampleTr: 毎週の小テストは生徒が新しい語彙を定着させるのに役立つ。
noteJa.meaning: 既にある知識や地位をより強固にする。
noteJa.usage: knowledge, position, learning などの名詞をとる。「統合する」の意味もある。

noteKo.exampleTr: 매주 보는 퀴즈는 학생들이 새 어휘를 다지는 데 도움이 된다.
noteKo.meaning: 이미 있는 지식이나 지위를 더 굳건하게 하다.
noteKo.usage: knowledge, position, learning 같은 명사와 함께 쓰며 '통합하다'의 뜻도 있다.

contend.ex: Farmers have to contend with bad weather.

continue.ex: The rain will continue all day.

counterparts.en: people or things in a similar position elsewhere
counterparts.ex: Our team met their Japanese counterparts in Tokyo.
counterparts.ja: 相当する相手；同等の者

example.en: Irish farmers earn less than their French counterparts.
example.zh: 愛爾蘭農民的收入比法國同行低。

note.meaning: 在別處擔任相同角色或處於相同地位的人或物。
note.usage: 常用 one's counterparts 或 counterparts in + 地方，用於比較。

noteEn.meaning: People or things with the same role in another place.
noteEn.usage: Used to compare groups, e.g. 'their European counterparts'.

noteEs.exampleTr: Los agricultores irlandeses ganan menos que sus homólogos franceses.
noteEs.meaning: Personas o cosas que ocupan el mismo papel en otro lugar.
noteEs.usage: Se usa para comparar: one's counterparts o counterparts in + lugar.

noteHi.exampleTr: आयरिश किसान अपने फ्रांसीसी समकक्षों से कम कमाते हैं।
noteHi.meaning: किसी दूसरी जगह पर समान भूमिका या स्थिति वाले लोग या चीज़ें।
noteHi.usage: तुलना करते समय one's counterparts या counterparts in + स्थान के रूप में प्रयोग होता है।

noteJa.exampleTr: アイルランドの農家はフランスの農家より収入が少ない。
noteJa.meaning: 別の場所で同じ役割や立場にある人や物。
noteJa.usage: 比較の際に one's counterparts や counterparts in + 場所 の形で使う。

noteKo.exampleTr: 아일랜드 농민은 프랑스 농민보다 수입이 적다.
noteKo.meaning: 다른 곳에서 같은 역할이나 지위에 있는 사람이나 사물.
noteKo.usage: 비교할 때 one's counterparts 또는 counterparts in + 장소 형태로 쓴다.

country.ex: Canada is a very large country.

culture.en: the customs, arts and way of life of a people
culture.ex: Food is an important part of every culture.

data.en: facts and numbers collected for study
data.ex: The app collects data about your sleep.

deepens.en: makes something stronger or more complete
deepens.ex: Travelling deepens our understanding of other people.

deficit.en: a lack or shortfall of something
deficit.ex: The school has a deficit of science teachers.

example.en: The country faces a deficit of qualified nurses.
example.zh: 這個國家面臨合格護理師短缺的問題。

note.meaning: 不足、缺口；本文指語言能力上的落後差距（也可指財政赤字）。
note.usage: 常用 a deficit in/of + 名詞；address/reduce a deficit 表示處理缺口。

noteEn.meaning: A lack or shortage of something needed.
noteEn.usage: Say 'a deficit in/of' something; also used for money.

noteEs.exampleTr: El país sufre un déficit de enfermeras cualificadas.
noteEs.meaning: Falta o carencia; aquí, el retraso en idiomas (también déficit económico).
noteEs.usage: Se usa a deficit in/of + sustantivo; address a deficit es afrontarlo.

noteHi.exampleTr: देश योग्य नर्सों की कमी का सामना कर रहा है।
noteHi.meaning: किसी चीज़ की कमी; यहाँ भाषा कौशल में कमी (वित्तीय घाटा भी हो सकता है)।
noteHi.usage: a deficit in/of + संज्ञा के साथ आता है; address a deficit यानी कमी दूर करना।

noteJa.exampleTr: その国は有資格の看護師不足に直面している。
noteJa.meaning: 不足や欠如。本文では語学力の遅れ（財政赤字の意味もある）。
noteJa.usage: a deficit in/of + 名詞 の形。address a deficit で「不足に対処する」。

noteKo.exampleTr: 그 나라는 자격 있는 간호사 부족 문제에 직면해 있다.
noteKo.meaning: 부족이나 결핍. 본문에서는 언어 능력의 격차(재정 적자의 뜻도 있음).
noteKo.usage: a deficit in/of + 명사 형태로 쓰며, address a deficit는 부족을 해결한다는 뜻.

department.en: a part of a government or organisation
department.ex: He works in the health department.

describes.ex: She describes the town as quiet and friendly.

development.ex: The company pays for the development of its managers.

early.ex: Early training made her a strong swimmer.

education.ex: Education is free for all children here.

encompasses.ex: The park encompasses forests, lakes and hills.

encouraging.en: helping someone want to do something

enhances.ex: Good lighting enhances the look of a room.

entering.ex: Students must show ID when entering the library.

entice.ex: Free coffee may entice more customers.

even.ex: It is even colder today than yesterday.

existing.ex: We will improve the existing system.

exposure.ex: Exposure to music at home helped her learn the piano.

example.en: Early exposure to books helps children read sooner.
example.zh: 及早接觸書本能幫助孩子更早學會閱讀。

note.meaning: 接觸、接觸機會；本文指孩子多接觸外語。
note.usage: 常用 exposure to + 名詞；也可指暴露於危險（exposure to the sun）。

noteEn.meaning: The chance to see, hear or experience something.
noteEn.usage: Use 'exposure to' something, e.g. 'exposure to languages'.

noteEs.exampleTr: El contacto temprano con los libros ayuda a los niños a leer antes.
noteEs.meaning: Contacto o experiencia con algo; aquí, el contacto con idiomas.
noteEs.usage: Se usa exposure to + sustantivo; también para peligros (exposure to the sun).

noteHi.exampleTr: किताबों से जल्दी संपर्क बच्चों को जल्दी पढ़ना सीखने में मदद करता है।
noteHi.meaning: किसी चीज़ से संपर्क या उसका अनुभव; यहाँ बच्चों का भाषाओं से संपर्क।
noteHi.usage: exposure to + संज्ञा के साथ आता है; खतरे के संपर्क के लिए भी प्रयोग होता है।

noteJa.exampleTr: 早くから本に触れることで、子どもは早く読めるようになる。
noteJa.meaning: 何かに触れること、接する機会。本文では外国語に触れること。
noteJa.usage: exposure to + 名詞 の形。危険にさらされる意味もある（exposure to the sun）。

noteKo.exampleTr: 책을 일찍 접하면 아이들이 더 빨리 읽게 된다.
noteKo.meaning: 무언가를 접하거나 경험하는 것. 본문에서는 외국어를 접하는 것.
noteKo.usage: exposure to + 명사 형태로 쓰며, 위험에 노출되는 뜻도 있다(exposure to the sun).

facilitates.ex: The new app facilitates contact between doctors and patients.

example.en: The new bridge facilitates trade between the two towns.
example.zh: 新橋促進了兩鎮之間的貿易。

note.usage: 主詞多為事物或計畫，後接名詞：facilitate learning；不說 facilitate someone to do。

noteEn.meaning: Makes something easier to do or happen.
noteEn.usage: Followed by a noun, e.g. 'facilitate learning'.

noteEs.exampleTr: El nuevo puente facilita el comercio entre los dos pueblos.
noteEs.meaning: Hacer que algo sea más fácil o posible.
noteEs.usage: Suele llevar un sustantivo: facilitate learning; no se dice facilitate someone to do.

noteHi.exampleTr: नया पुल दोनों कस्बों के बीच व्यापार को सुगम बनाता है।
noteHi.meaning: किसी काम को आसान बनाना या बढ़ावा देना।
noteHi.usage: आमतौर पर वस्तु या योजना कर्ता होती है और संज्ञा आती है: facilitate learning।

noteJa.exampleTr: 新しい橋が二つの町の間の交易を促進している。
noteJa.meaning: 物事を容易にする、促進する。
noteJa.usage: 主語は物や計画が多く、名詞を目的語にとる（facilitate learning）。

noteKo.exampleTr: 새 다리는 두 마을 간의 교역을 촉진한다.
noteKo.usage: 주어는 주로 사물이나 계획이며 명사 목적어를 취한다(facilitate learning).

fact.ex: Despite the fact that it rained, we enjoyed the trip.

familiarises.en: helps someone get to know something
familiarises.ex: The tour familiarises new staff with the building.

feature.en: to be included as an important part
feature.ex: Fresh fish should feature in a healthy diet.
feature.ja: 含まれる；取り入れられる

feel.en: to have a feeling or emotion
feel.ex: Warm tea makes me feel better on cold days.

figure.ex: The official figure shows rising unemployment.

finances.ex: The bank finances small local businesses.

foot.en: set foot in: enter a place
foot.ex: He had never set foot in a museum before.

foreign.ex: Learning a foreign language opens many doors.

fosters.ex: Group work fosters cooperation among students.

found.ex: The study found that sleep improves memory.

funded.en: paid for by a person or group
funded.ex: The library is funded by the city council.

funds.ex: The city funds free swimming lessons for kids.

gaelscoil.en: an Irish-language school (part of a name)
gaelscoil.ja: ゲールスコイル（アイルランド語学校）

games.ex: The children played games in the garden.

gap.en: a difference between two groups or things
gap.ex: The gap between rich and poor is growing.

girl.ex: The girl next door plays the violin.

goal.ex: My goal is to run a marathon next year.

grammar.ex: She checked the grammar before sending the email.

grasp.ex: He has a good grasp of basic maths.

griffith.zh: 格里菲斯（校名的一部分）

has.ex: She has lived here for years.

having.en: used to form a perfect participle
having.ex: Having finished dinner, we went for a walk.

help.ex: Volunteers help older people with shopping.

helps.ex: This app helps people learn languages.

her.en: belonging to a woman already mentioned

high.ex: Prices can be as high as fifty euros.

home.ex: Many students rent a room in a family home.

imbalance.en: a situation where things are not equal
imbalance.ex: There is an imbalance between boys and girls in the club.

immerses.ex: The trip immerses students in local life.

in.en: inside; at a time or place

incorporates.en: includes something as part of a whole
incorporates.ex: The chef incorporates local herbs into every dish.

indicate.en: show or suggest that something is true
indicate.ex: Early results indicate that the plan is working.

initiative.en: a new plan to solve or improve something
initiative.ex: The town started a new recycling initiative.

interest.en: wanting to know or do something
interest.ex: He showed no interest in sport.

introduces.en: helps someone learn about something new
introduces.ex: The guide introduces visitors to the history of the castle.

keep.ex: Prices keep going up every month.

lags.en: moves or develops more slowly than others
lags.ex: Our town lags behind the city in internet speed.

example.en: Rural areas still lag behind cities in broadband access.
example.zh: 鄉村地區在寬頻網路普及方面仍落後於城市。

note.meaning: 落後，發展或進度比別人慢。
note.usage: 常用 lag behind + 對象；也可作名詞 a time lag（時間差）。

noteEn.meaning: To be slower or less advanced than others.

noteEs.exampleTr: Las zonas rurales todavía van a la zaga de las ciudades en acceso a banda ancha.
noteEs.meaning: Quedarse atrás o avanzar más despacio que otros.
noteEs.usage: Suele usarse como lag behind + algo; también existe el sustantivo time lag.

noteHi.exampleTr: ब्रॉडबैंड पहुँच में ग्रामीण क्षेत्र अब भी शहरों से पीछे हैं।
noteHi.meaning: दूसरों से पीछे रह जाना या धीमी प्रगति करना।
noteHi.usage: आमतौर पर lag behind + किसी के साथ आता है; संज्ञा रूप time lag भी है।

noteJa.exampleTr: 農村部はブロードバンドの普及でいまだに都市部に遅れをとっている。
noteJa.meaning: 他より遅れること、発展が遅いこと。
noteJa.usage: lag behind + 対象 の形が多い。名詞 time lag（時間差）もある。

noteKo.exampleTr: 농촌 지역은 여전히 초고속 인터넷 보급에서 도시보다 뒤처져 있다.
noteKo.usage: 주로 lag behind + 대상 형태로 쓰며, 명사 time lag(시간 차)도 있다.

language.en: a system of words used by a people
language.ex: Spanish is a popular language to learn.

languages.en: systems of words used by peoples
languages.ex: He can read three languages fluently.

learn.ex: Kids learn new words very fast.

lessons.en: periods of time spent teaching a subject
lessons.ex: His piano lessons are on Fridays.

level.ex: She is now teaching at university level.

like.ex: I would like a cup of tea, please.

maintain.ex: He maintains that the plan will work.

marking.ex: The shop is marking its first year with a sale.

may.ex: Kids may start school at four.
may.ja: …かもしれない；…することがある

mere.ex: The tickets sold out in a mere ten minutes.

modern.ex: French is a modern language taught in many schools.

moment.ex: She called me the moment she arrived.

moreover.ex: The flat is cheap; moreover, it is near the station.

much.en: much of: a large part of

multi-denominational.en: open to children of all religions
multi-denominational.ex: They chose a multi-denominational school for their son.

multilingual.ex: The city has a large multilingual population.

multilingualism.en: the ability to use several languages

number.ex: The number of visitors rose last year.

objective.ex: The main objective is to cut costs.

offers.en: gives people the chance to have something
offers.ex: The gym offers free classes for beginners.

old.ex: The bridge is two hundred years old.

out.ex: She set out to write a book in a year.

overarching.ex: Safety is the overarching concern of the project.

example.en: The overarching goal of the plan is to reduce waste.
example.zh: 這項計畫的首要目標是減少浪費。

note.meaning: 首要的、涵蓋一切的，指統領各部分的最主要目標或主題。
note.usage: 只放在名詞前，常搭配 aim、goal、theme、objective。

noteEn.meaning: Most important and covering all parts.

noteEs.exampleTr: El objetivo general del plan es reducir los residuos.
noteEs.meaning: Principal y que abarca todo lo demás.
noteEs.usage: Va siempre delante del sustantivo: overarching goal, theme, objective.

noteHi.exampleTr: योजना का सर्वोपरि लक्ष्य कचरा कम करना है।
noteHi.meaning: सबसे महत्वपूर्ण और सब कुछ समेटने वाला।
noteHi.usage: केवल संज्ञा से पहले आता है; aim, goal, theme, objective के साथ आम है।

noteJa.exampleTr: その計画の最大の目標は廃棄物を減らすことだ。
noteJa.meaning: 全体を包括する最も重要な。
noteJa.usage: 名詞の前のみで使い、aim, goal, theme, objective とよく結びつく。

noteKo.exampleTr: 그 계획의 가장 중요한 목표는 쓰레기를 줄이는 것이다.
noteKo.usage: 명사 앞에서만 쓰이며 aim, goal, theme, objective와 자주 어울린다.

pays.ex: The company pays for staff training.

people.ex: Many people came to the festival.

per.ex: The ticket costs ten euro per person.

persevere.ex: If you persevere, you will improve at the guitar.

example.en: He persevered with the violin and now plays in an orchestra.
example.zh: 他堅持學小提琴，現在在管弦樂團演奏。

note.meaning: 堅持不懈，遇到困難仍繼續努力。
note.usage: 常用 persevere with/in + 名詞；名詞為 perseverance。

noteEn.meaning: To keep trying even when it is hard.

noteEs.exampleTr: Perseveró con el violín y ahora toca en una orquesta.
noteEs.meaning: Seguir esforzándose a pesar de las dificultades.
noteEs.usage: Se usa persevere with/in + sustantivo; el sustantivo es perseverance.

noteHi.exampleTr: वह वायलिन सीखने में डटा रहा और अब एक ऑर्केस्ट्रा में बजाता है।

noteJa.exampleTr: 彼はバイオリンを根気よく続け、今ではオーケストラで演奏している。
noteJa.meaning: 困難があっても努力を続けること。
noteJa.usage: persevere with/in + 名詞 の形。名詞は perseverance。

noteKo.exampleTr: 그는 바이올린을 꾸준히 계속해서 지금은 오케스트라에서 연주한다.
noteKo.usage: persevere with/in + 명사 형태로 쓰며, 명사형은 perseverance이다.

note.meaning: 精通的、熟練的，指對某種技能或語言掌握得很好。

noteEn.meaning: Very good at a skill or language.

noteEs.exampleTr: Llegó a dominar el español tras un año en Madrid.

note.meaning: 支持者、擁護者，指公開支持某觀點或計畫的人。

paragraphs: Children in Irish schools learn Irish and English. But not many people in Ireland speak a third language.
Only about 15% of people in Ireland speak a second language well. In Europe, the number is up to 59%.
A programme called Say Yes to Languages wants to change this. It is five years old. It pays for language teachers to visit primary schools. It also trains teachers in the schools.
Amy Kelly teaches German at a school in Roscommon. Her classes use games, songs and videos. She thinks all primary schools should teach a foreign language.
At a school in Dublin, families speak about 25 languages at home. A ten-year-old girl there is learning French. Teachers say learning languages early helps children feel confident.

Children in Ireland start learning Irish when they begin school. But compared with the rest of Europe, few people in Ireland can speak another language. According to the 2022 census, about 15% of people in Ireland speak a second language well, while in Europe the figure can be as high as 59%.

A programme called Say Yes to Languages, paid for by the Department of Education and Youth, is trying to change this. It is now five years old. It pays for language tutors to visit primary schools and offers training for teachers. Its aim is to help pupils continue with a language in secondary school.

Amy Kelly has taught German at Gaelscoil de hÍde in Roscommon for 17 years. Her lessons use games, videos, songs and rhymes, and pupils also learn about German culture. She would like every primary school to teach a foreign language.

At Griffith Barracks Multi-Denominational School in Dublin, families speak about 25 languages. Teacher Clare Dunne says interest in languages there is very strong. One ten-year-old pupil is in her second year of French.
Teachers say that learning languages early builds confidence and communication skills, and even helps children understand grammar in Irish and English.

Although children in Ireland begin learning Irish as soon as they start school, the country lags behind much of Europe when it comes to speaking other languages. Census 2022 found that about 15 per cent of the population are proficient in a second language, compared with up to 59 per cent of Europeans.

Say Yes to Languages, a programme funded by the Department of Education and Youth, aims to close that gap. Now marking its fifth anniversary, it pays for visiting language tutors in primary schools and provides training for existing staff, with the goal of encouraging pupils to keep studying a language in secondary school.

Amy Kelly, who has taught German at Gaelscoil de hÍde in Roscommon for 17 years, builds her lessons around games, videos, songs and rhymes, and introduces pupils to German culture. She believes a modern foreign language should be taught in every primary school.
At Griffith Barracks Multi-Denominational School in Dublin, where around 25 languages are spoken across the school community, teacher Clare Dunne reports a very positive response to the scheme.
Supporters argue that early language learning boosts children's confidence and communication skills, and even deepens their understanding of grammar in both Irish and English.
